name: Special City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
City of La Habra Heights
  AGENDA REPORT

 To:  City Council Members  Meeting of:  June 28, 2016

 From:  Shauna Clark, City Manager

 SUBJECT:  INTERIM CITY MANAGER APPOINTMENT AND EMPLOYMENT
  AGREEMENT – THOMAS ROBINSON
BACKGROUND
With the departure of the current City Manager effective July 7, 2016, the City will need
an interim city manager. Retired La Mirada City Manager Tom Robinson has agreed to
accept the position on an interim basis until a new City Manager is hired. Government
Code Section 21221(h) permits retired annuitants under the California Public Employees’
Retirement System (CalPERS) to be employed without reinstatement from retirement to
fill a vacant position on an interim basis during a recruitment.
Mr. Robinson served as City Manager of the City of La Mirada from August 2008 until
September 2013. His experience also includes seven years as Director of Community
Services and six years as director of Community Resources for La Mirada. Mr. Robinson
will be providing day-to-day management of the City until a permanent City Manager is
hired or until he has been paid for 960 hours, whichever occurs first. During his tenure
he will use his proven abilities to provide leadership for the City and the community.
FISCAL IMPACT
The City Manager/Community Development Director/City Clerk position is currently
funded in the FY 2015/2016 budget. Mr. Robinson will receive the same hourly rate as
the current City Manager/Community Development Director/City Clerk, $79.23 per hour;
however, without benefits and working an average of 30 hours per week this appointment
will save the City approximately $36,000 if Mr. Robinson is retained for the full 960 hours.
RECOMMENDATION:
Approve Resolution 2016-__ authorizing an employment agreement with Thomas
Robinson as Interim City Manager/Community Development Director/City Clerk effective
July 8, 2016.

ATTACHMENTS
1. Resolution 2016-___
2. Employment Agreement
3. Resume of Thomas Robinson
